## Objective
- Build a complete, playable three-player co-op dungeon crawler roguelite with randomly generated floors, increasing difficulty, and a choice of one random reward from three options after each floor.

## Requirements
- Include at least seven selectable classes.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest one.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone browser game using HTML, CSS, and Canvas JavaScript.
- Three heroes share one keyboard; one player can also control the party.
- Floors end when all enemies are defeated and a hero reaches the exit.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a game screen, class selection for eight classes, generated dungeon rooms and corridors, enemy combat, party abilities, escalating floors, and three-option random rewards.
- Added responsive layout and keyboard controls.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Validate gameplay in a browser and fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- Browser screenshot/testing is blocked: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` reported `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome`.

## Next Move
1. Install or otherwise provide Chromium, then open the game and test class selection, combat, floor progression, and rewards.
2. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; fix any visible or gameplay issues.
3. Check `git status` and report final changes and any assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page structure and interface.
- `style.css`: Game styling and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Class definitions, dungeon generation, combat, controls, rewards, and rendering.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The user’s request was repeated verbatim; it remains the active build objective.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable three-player co-op dungeon crawler roguelite with randomly generated floors, escalating difficulty, and a choice of one random reward from three options after each floor.

## Requirements
- Include at least seven selectable classes; don’t ask clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest one.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML/CSS/Canvas game; three heroes share one keyboard, and one player can control the party.
- Floors clear after all enemies are defeated; reaching the exit advances the party to a reward choice.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added eight selectable classes, randomized dungeon rooms and corridors, combat, class skills, floor progression, and random three-option rewards.
- Added responsive interface, keyboard controls, status panels, and run record display.
- Installed Chromium and opened the game in Playwright.
- `node --check game.js` passes.

### Active
- Fix the browser runtime error found during gameplay validation, then test class selection, combat, floor progression, and rewards.
- Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser rendering currently logs `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')` in `draw` at `game.js:39`; the canvas attempts to read an uninitialized/empty map before a run starts.
- Browser also reports a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), which is nonessential.

## Next Move
1. Guard or initialize dungeon map state so the title/class-selection screen draws without errors.
2. Reload in Playwright; test class selection, gameplay, and floor/reward progression.
3. Save and inspect a small JPEG screenshot, then run `node --check game.js` and check `git status`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page layout and interface.
- `style.css`: Game styling and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Class definitions, dungeon generation, combat, controls, rewards, and rendering.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The browser is open at `http://localhost:3002`; console log is `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/console-2026-11-10T20-37-05-933Z.log`.
- The initial screenshot/browser check has not yet been completed.
